name: hackernews
description: Replies to your Hacker News comments and stories, and new stories and comments that match your keywords, read through the public Hacker News search. No login. Read-only: it cannot post or vote.

requires.help: Create a small text file with your Hacker News username and the words you want to follow, and save it there. Example: { "username": "your_hn_name", "keywords": ["sqlite", "\"local first\""] }. Either part may be left out. No password is needed or wanted. Details: extractors/hackernews/README.md.
